enemies.cleanup_prompt: Perform ONLY a cleanup on this existing pixel-art sprite atlas. Preserve every character pose, facing, anatomy, equipment, camera, row and column placement, count and artwork. Remove ALL detached tiny red/brown marks, short horizontal red streaks, ground shadows, ground marks and stray pixels beneath the feet or between the characters. Keep only the actual soldier silhouettes, weapons, brass pipes and boots on a genuinely transparent background. Especially remove red horizontal fragments BELOW the feet in the lower-left-facing rows. No floor, no cast shadows, no effects, no red dust or presentation marks. Keep all eight directional rows exactly in place: north/back, northeast/back-right, east/right, southeast/front-right, south/front, southwest/front-left, west/left, northwest/back-left. Do not rotate or change poses. Do not add new poses. Preserve all pixels belonging to the actual characters as closely as possible, and make everything else transparent. Hard pixel-art edges, no antialiasing.

prompt_reconstruction: Concatenate common_prompt + enemy_prompt_suffixes[id] to recover each exact submitted prompt.
common_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, multi-direction pixel-art game sprite animation atlas.
Redraw the SAME enemy from reference in ALL EIGHT compass directions, for an arena shooter viewed by an orthographic camera elevated60degrees ABOVE THE GROUND. Camera remains fixed for whole sheet; only character's physical facing changes in3D. High-angle RTS units like StarCraft, dark military sci-fi with brass/copper steam machinery, native MegaDrive pixel clusters. Preserve the referenced armor, materials, color, boiler, weapon, proportions.
ONE ATLAS: EXACTLY TEN COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS. Intended native canvas320x384pixels, eachcell32x48. No gutters, no margins. EXACTLY80complete compact poses of ONE enemy. Every row is ONE fixed orientation with10poses. First4columns(idle0..3), last6columns(run0..5), full cyclic motion in place. Row order is mandatory:
ROW0 NORTH: walking/shooting UPscreen, DIRECT REAR VIEW; helmet BACK, back armor and boiler visible, face and visor must NOT be visible. Gun aimsUP.
ROW1 NORTHEAST: UP-RIGHTscreen, rear3/4 view; back and right side visible, mostly BACK of helmet; gunUP-RIGHT.
ROW2 EAST/L: RIGHTscreen, right-facing elevated SIDE VIEW; gunRIGHT.
ROW3 SOUTHEAST: DOWN-RIGHTscreen, front3/4 view matching reference, helmet visor and front armor visible; gunDOWN-RIGHT.
ROW4 SOUTH: DOWNscreen, DIRECT FRONT VIEW from high above, symmetric shoulder tops around head, front visor visible, chest and gun foreshortened; gunDOWN.
ROW5 SOUTHWEST: DOWN-LEFTscreen, front3/4LEFT view; gunDOWN-LEFT.
ROW6 WEST/O: LEFTscreen, left-facing elevated SIDE VIEW; gunLEFT.
ROW7 NORTHWEST: UP-LEFTscreen, rear3/4LEFT view; back boiler and helmetback visible; gunUP-LEFT.
Absolutely distinguish NORTH/back and SOUTH/front! Draw the character physically turning, NOT rotating or vertically flipping a flat sprite. Top of helmet remains top on screen for every direction; NEVER upside down. Camera elevation stays60degreesaboveground throughALL80poses. See large upper planes of helmet, shoulders and boiler. Face only a small rim in frontal views; no face visible on rear view. Body anatomy and equipment stay fixed. Only horizontal mirroring is acceptable for corresponding left/rightfacings. Idle subtle breathing4poses feet stable. Run6distinctposes with alternating legs contact/push/passing/suspension/opposite-contact/recovery and a loopback. No global drift.
Each pose fully fits its32x48cell; consistent scale acrossALL8directions and poses, feet pivotlocal(16,46), compact limbs and weapons. All80cells occupied, no missing frames. No texts/numbers/arrows/directionlabels/gridlines/floor/background/scenery/shadows/watermarks. True transparent PNG background.
Draw directly at FINALPIXELARTscale, no antialiasing/blur/gradient/glow/sem-transparentedges. Explicit flat pixelclusters and economical2tone shading. SINGLEsharedpalette index0transparent +15opaquevisiblecolorsONLY: #000000, #242424, #494949, #6D6D6D, #929292, #DBDBB6, #492400, #926D24, #DBB649, #6D0000, #DB2424, #DBDB24, #49246D, #9249B6, #DB6D00. Keep enough light pixels for darkscenery readability.
